|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ⚠️ | Don't close the issue: the PR description now says "Part of #16189", but there has been no new push, so the commit message is unchanged |
| ❌ | Explain how the fixture was captured: the description says it was constructed from Atlassian's spec and existing fixtures, not captured from a real Jira instance, which the fixture guidelines require |
| ✅ | Add a dev-environment screenshot to the description |
| ℹ️ | A maintainer has already said on a related Jira PR (#39998) that Zulip does not accept constructed fixtures |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to capture a real `attachment_created` payload and push the commit message fix.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the updates, @huriazahra! The fixture needs to be captured from a real Jira instance rather than built by hand from the API spec, as described in the [fixture guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/webhooks/incoming-webhooks-walkthrough.html#fixture-guidelines). Please also push the commit message change, since we don't see a new push yet.
```
